section_summary.extract_value: This section details the methodology for measuring social connections in 'our study'. Participants' social relationships were assessed using the Interview Measure of Social Relationships (IMSR) to determine primary group size, and an adapted method based on the mean number of Christmas cards sent (conventional and electronic) was used to estimate the size of the broader secondary social network.
